core_features: Central romantic relationship with a comedic or light tone
Misunderstandings, awkward situations, and emotional growth
Ultimately uplifting or at least hopeful resolution
typical_settings: Workplaces, cafes, city streets, shared apartments
typical_conflicts: External obstacles to being together (jobs, families, timing)
protagonist_archetypes: Two flawed but likable leads (any gender pairing)
tone_guidelines: Light, witty, emotionally warm; can include moments of genuine pain, but overall comforting.

required_elements: Two main romantic leads with clear chemistry
Several comedic or awkward situations tied to the romantic plot
A turning point where emotional honesty becomes necessary
An ending that is at least emotionally hopeful for the relationship
forbidden_elements: Romance completely sidelined by unrelated plotlines
